title: 📌 Environmental Governance — Solid Waste Management Rules 2026, 98 Ramsar Sites & Bio-Bitumen
summary: Central government notified country's first Tailings Policy for extracting critical minerals from mine dumps, slags, and tailing ponds. IBM, CMPDI, and AMD to analyze dumps to determine companionality.

blocks.content: **Overview**: Central government notified country's first Tailings Policy for extracting critical minerals from mine dumps, slags, and tailing ponds. IBM, CMPDI, and AMD to analyze dumps to determine companionality.

items: **Mines Ministry Notifies India’s First Tailings Policy for Critical Minerals Recovery** (Page 7): Central government notified country's first Tailings Policy for extracting critical minerals from mine dumps, slags, and tailing ponds. IBM, CMPDI, and AMD to analyze dumps to determine companionality.

**India Becomes First in World to Commercially Produce Bio-Bitumen in Road Construction** (Page 63): Nitin Gadkari announced India became first country to commercially produce bio-bitumen developed by CSIR to substitute crude oil bitumen.

**Patna Bird Sanctuary (UP) and Chhari-Dhand (Gujarat) Designated as Ramsar Sites (Total 98)** (Page 89): India Ramsar sites increased to 98 with inclusion of Patna Bird Sanctuary (Etah, UP) and Chhari-Dhand (Kutch, Gujarat).

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Circular Economy & Biodiversity Protection. SWM Rules 2026 mandating 4-stream segregation, Ramsar network expands to 98 sites (Patna Bird Sanctuary & Chhari-Dhand), and CSIR Bio-Bitumen debut.
